title: Lower & Abs
description: Lower body and abs in two classic blocks: pulse squats and good morning then dynamic core

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, rotate from side to side

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Stay low in the squat, small up-and-down pulses

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.instructions: Hands behind head, hinge the torso keeping the back straight

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch feet

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, rapid kicks

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, fully raise the torso, touch feet

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
